content: ग्राम्य {%a.%} [ग्राम-यत्] .²1 Relating to or used in a village; संत्यज्य ग्राम्यमाहारम् <ls>Ms. 6. 3</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 120</ls>. .²2 Living in a village, rural, rustic; अल्पव्ययेन सुन्दरि ग्राम्यजनो मिष्टमश्नाति <ls>Chand. M. 1</ls>. .²3 Domesticated, tame (as an animal). .²4 Cultivated (<ab>opp.</ab> वन्य ‘growing wild’). .²5 Low, vulgar, used only by low people (as a word); चुम्बनं देहि मे भार्ये कामचाण्डालतृप्तये <ls>R. G.</ls>, or कटिस्ते हरते मनः <ls>S. D. 574</ls>, are instances of ग्राम्य expressions; तस्मात्संप्रतिपत्तिरेव हि वरं न ग्राम्यमत्रोत्तरम् <ls>Mu. 5. 18</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 5. 2. 17</ls>. .²6 Indecent, obscene. .²7 Relating to sexual pleasures. .²8 Relating to a musical scale. .{@-म्यः@} .²1 A villager; <ls>Y. 2. 166</ls>. .²2 A tame hog. .²3 The first two signs of the zodiac, {%Aries%} and {%Taurus%}. .{@-म्या@} The Indigo plant. .{@-म्यम्@} .²1 A rustic speech. .²2 Food prepared in a village. .²3 Sexual intercourse. .²4 Acceptance. .²5 The Prakṛt and other dialects.
